AppNest

As developers, innovation is in our DNA. The thrill of creating something unique, something that has never existed before, is what drives us forward.

Today, we’re thrilled to introduce you to a platform that not only celebrates innovation but also provides the tools to turn your creative visions into reality — **AppNest**.

Are you a passionate developer seeking a new avenue for your creativity? Look no further.

AppNest seamlessly merges the prowess of SurveySparrow’s experience management and ThriveSparrow’s employee success solution with your boundless innovation. Beyond surveys, this platform empowers businesses to personalize experiences and foster success.

Now, it’s your turn to take the reins. Shape the future by crafting applications that align perfectly with your business requirements.

**Do you have a unique challenge that demands a custom solution?**

AppNest is your canvas. From streamlining workflows to revolutionizing user interactions, AppNest equips you with the tools to conquer any obstacle. The power to create, iterate, and amaze is in your hands.

## Why Opt for AppNest?

- Build apps for your requirements without much dependency
- Implement custom solutions as the need arises
- A [**vibrant community**](https://community.surveysparrow.dev/) ready to support you throughout the app development process.

Join the creative movement!!

Today marks the beginning of a new chapter in your development journey. The canvas is ready, the tools are at your disposal, and the community is waiting. Are you ready to elevate your creativity, innovate fearlessly, and make your mark?

Stay tuned as we delve deeper into the features, success stories, and experiences that define [**https://developers.surveysparrow.com/appnest**](https://developers.surveysparrow.com/appnest). The world of boundless innovation awaits.

Your journey starts now.

## SurveySparrow Software Development Kit (SSDK)

[**SurveySparrow Software Development Kit (SSDK)**](https://sdk.surveysparrow.dev/) is an SDK with software development tools and libraries that enable developers to create apps in AppNest. SSDK includes tools for testing apps locally. It also provides documentation and sample templates to get started.

## App Development cycle with SSDK

App Development Cycle with SSDK

If you’re just beginning with SurveySparrow or ThriveSparrow, follow these steps to kickstart your journey. The process involves several key stages:

## Prepare Your Environment:

Please refer the [SSDK documentation](https://sdk.surveysparrow.dev/) for the detailed instructions on how to install the following technologies.

- Install NVM (Node Version Manager).
- Install Node.js version 18(JavaScript runtime).
- Install Mkcert (SSL certificate manager).
- Set up an account on SurveySparrow.

## **Ensure Browser Compatibility:**

- Make sure you’re using a modern web browser like Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, or Microsoft Edge.

## **Install and Update Tools:**

- Confirm that you have the latest version of the SSDK CLI installed.
- Set up a code editor such as Visual Studio Code, Sublime Text, or a similar tool.

## **Knowledge and Skills:**

- Familiarise yourself with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- Gain proficiency in using browser development tools for debugging and development.

Getting started with building apps in AppNest is easy with simple commands in CLI.

## Install SSDK

If you are already using the SSDK, skip this step. If you are installing SSDK for the first time, follow the instructions.

1\. Use Node Package Manager (NPM) to install the latest CLI

```
npm install https://ssdk.surveysparrow.dev/ssdk.tgz -g
```

2\. Verify the installation using the command below

```
ssdk version
```

Press enter or click to view image in full size

![](https://miro.medium.com/v2/resize:fit:700/0*jRM66BCH9ggHtXei)

3\. Create your app

```
ssdk version
```

4\. Set up your app. Select **SurveySparrow** and press “enter”

5\. Select **your\_first\_app**

6\. To start the app in the **local environment**, run the following the command.

```
ssdk run
```

7\. Navigate to the below URL to find your local application

[**https://yourdomain.surveysparrow.com/settings/marketplace-apps?dev=true**](https://yourdomain.surveysparrow.com/settings/marketplace-apps?dev=true)

Press enter or click to view image in full size

![](https://miro.medium.com/v2/resize:fit:700/0*D8LjeHWCpxjletdj)

Please refer to the official [SSDK documentation](https://sdk.surveysparrow.dev/) and [playlist](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TTvFcAXODzM&list=PL_KODN9mFNjzavxGeodcTMY2iwAPaK-i-&index=1&ab_channel=SurveySparrow) for more detailed instructions.

## Why Choose SSDK for Your App Development Journey

- **Simplify Your Path to Success:** Benefit from pre-built functions and keywords $Fetch, $Storage, $Iparams, and much more.
- **Ensuring Seamless Integration:** Integrating third-party applications has been simplified with the help of SSDK CLI’s advanced authentication features.
- **Accelerate Your Progress:** Direct your focus towards app features instead of getting bogged down by low-level development tasks
- **Elevate Your App’s Quality:** Leverage the power of SSDK to enhance Efficiency, minimize errors, and elevate your app’s overall performance

## Developer Portal

- Portal is an automation for creating and deploying Marketplace app resources with simple steps by developers.
- To Navigate the Developer Portal — Log in to your SurveySparrow **account -> Click Settings -> Apps and Integrations -> Developer Portal**

Press enter or click to view image in full size

![](https://miro.medium.com/v2/resize:fit:700/0*Gg5v-BfjnGeVAqdl)

- Click **+New app**, upload the app with the required details, and click Publish.

Press enter or click to view image in full size

![](https://miro.medium.com/v2/resize:fit:700/0*B_MK0ycBX6BoYAAy)

- The uploaded app will be available on the App and Integrations page for installation, and the app will be available in the respective location. For eg: [**https://yourdomain.surveysparrow.com/settings/marketplace-apps**](https://yourdomain.surveysparrow.com/settings/marketplace-apps)
